name: tpl-responded-existence-2-goal
task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) captures 'if you move the ball, you must also take the key' (key may come before or after), and the hard Existence(target_picked_up) plus hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) captures the goal with its stated order; the Precedence chain also forces door_open, so no extra clauses are needed.

texts: If blocker_moved happens, has_door_key must happen at some time before or after.
Pick up the target box, after door_open.
target_picked_up can only happen after door_open has happened.
